title: Re-read a cold delegation child's window when only a status read stamped it, instead of refusing a follow-up or review capture with a conflict
outcome: install_cold_session_window (src/cold_transcript.rs) refuses a window whose record stamp moved since it was read off-lock, and hydrate_cold_session_window then fails the follow-up or review capture with a conflict. get_delegation on a terminal delegation stamps the child unconditionally through session_mut_by_index (src/delegations.rs, detach and status paths), so a status poll that lands during the window read makes the operation fail with a retryable conflict, even though the transcript did not change. Fix direction: re-read the window a bounded number of times on a stamp mismatch, as get_delegation_result_output now does. Provenance: a Low from the Claude reviewer of round-6 pair B3C1-PAIR6-9868EEDF (resultId review-result-afa7701272875818ca3569e81057f68bbcbe3d942d53bb0fde08bd571e16e419, attempt 1) on w-b3c1cd1bcea1. The result-output half of that Low is fixed in the change itself; the install half is this item.
acceptance: Re-read a cold delegation child's window when only a status read stamped it, instead of refusing a follow-up or review capture with a conflict is done
